# PR #2405: Patch: a player watching the finished match's replay is still taken to the rematch both sides agreed to

Closes #2382

## What changed

`apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx`: the replay branch (`watching !== null && view.result !== null`) now renders `RematchWatcher` beside `OpenedReplay` inside `CatalogContext.Provider`, behind the same `series === null` gate the board rail uses. A seat that offered a rematch and opened the replay while waiting is now navigated to `/match/<id>` when both offers create the new game, exactly as already happened from the board. Series games mount no watcher in either branch, and leaving the replay unmounts the watcher and shows the result panel as before.

`apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx`: added `stubHeldRematchFetch`/`AGREED` and two tests in the R672 describe block — replay navigates to `/match/match-2` once the held polls answer, and a series game navigates nowhere from board or replay while Back restores the result panel.

## How it was tested

- `sh scripts/build-wasm.sh && pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/routes/match.test.tsx` — 60 of 60 passed, including the two new tests and the existing R768000 replay test.
- `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/routes/match.tsx apps/web/src/routes/match.test.tsx` — clean.
- `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` — clean.
- `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo jackioh spec check` — clean.

## Decisions

None beyond the plan, which was followed exactly: no new ruling (client navigation that already exists on the board), `Rematch.tsx` untouched, watcher placed inside the provider as a sibling of `OpenedReplay`. No departures from the plan.

A reviewer should look twice at the second new test's negative assertions — they depend on the releases happening only after `series-banner` / replay step 0 appear, in the order written.
